about.title: Our Story
about.headline: Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency,
about.description: Headquartered in Delhi, offices in Jaipur and Hyderabad, Reinvent Digital offers 360-degree digital marketing services, built around the outcome that matters most: patients who walk in. From first lead to walk-in, you see every step in one clear dashboard.

sections.heading: From Ads to Walk-Ins, One Reliable Team for Every Step in Between
body: Reinvent Digital began in 2015, with healthcare as most of our work from day one. Our first client, a multi-location, renowned dental chain, grew from 60 to 400+ clinics with us. Other healthcare groups followed: 271% more conversions in 6 months, 232% more organic traffic in a year. These exceptional results are what made us decide to focus on healthcare alone.

But one gap kept coming back: clients wanted walk-ins, not just reports. So we went beyond marketing and built our, India's first, Patient Acquisition System, with our own healthcare CRM at its core, backed by 1 lakh+ tracked walk-ins across 120+ clinic locations.
sections.highlight: One Team. One Dashboard. One Goal: The Patient Walk-Ins You Want.

journey.heading: 11 Years of Milestones & What Our Future Direction Is

milestones.title: Founding year
milestones.body: Founded in Delhi, with healthcare clients shaping our work from day one.

milestones.title: Jaipur office
milestones.body: Expanded our team to Jaipur, with a full commitment to healthcare digital marketing.

founder.heading: If We Can't Prove the Number We Won't Show It To You
founder.body: When I started Reinvent Digital in 2015, I believed healthcare marketing deserved more than clicks and impressions. Clinic owners don't need another report. They need to know how many patients walked in, and what each one cost. I still stay close to the work, from strategy calls to the numbers in client reports. If we can't prove a number, we won't show it to you. That's the standard my team holds itself to, and why clients trust us with their growth.
founder.name: Jaydeep Meena
founder.imageAlt: Jaydeep Meena, founder of Reinvent Digital

items.title: Vision
items.body: To make patient walk-ins, not leads or clicks, the standard every healthcare brand in India measures its marketing by.

items.title: Mission
items.body: To give healthcare brands one accountable team, from the first search to the patient in the clinic, with every result tracked and proven.

closing.heading: Get the Gap Between Leads & Walk-Ins Filled Without Any Delay
closing.body: See how the Reinvent Digital Patient Acquisition System connects your campaigns, call team and CRM, and how every walk-in is tracked back to its source.

faqs.a: Reinvent Digital was founded by Jaydeep Meena in September 2015 in Delhi. He brings 20+ years of experience in digital marketing and media, and remains closely involved in client strategy and reporting today.
Reinvent Digital is headquartered in Delhi, with offices in Jaipur and Hyderabad. The team also serves healthcare clients in cities including Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, Noida, Gurgaon and Kochi.
